topic: North Pole cosmic mountain — biblical six-text convergence

our_argument_summary: WIN-031 (verdict Unfalsifiable) argues that the dome's claimed six-text biblical convergence on a northern cosmic mountain (Isaiah 14:13, Psalm 48:2, Job 26:7, Job 37:22, Ezekiel 1:4, 1 Enoch 17-18) is retrodiction, not confirmed prediction: (1) all six texts predate the dome model by ~2-3 millennia; (2) the axis-mundi archetype appears in cross-culturally contradictory geometries (Puranic center-of-flat-disc Meru, Aryabhatan north-pole-of-sphere Meru, Norse vertical-axis Yggdrasil, Islamic perimeter Qaf, Mesopotamian Ḫursag/E-kur center-of-flat-earth), giving textual convergence zero discriminating power between cosmologies; and (3) the dome's own monitor.py has no test domain for this WIN, yet the WIN is still counted toward the 69 confirmed / 94.5% scorecard. The c8 review found four minor and one moderate holes across this argument; the c9 pass verifies four of five have been addressed in current text (Meru characterization, Yggdrasil descriptor, centuries-to-millennia phrasing, named carve-out fraction) and identifies one substantively new problem: the carve-out example cites WIN-034 as part of the theological-cross-reference Unfalsifiable cluster, but WIN-034 was re-classified Self-Contradicted on 2026-05-14 (WIN-034.c3), 11 days after c8 was written — so the current text (data/wins.json:WIN-031.detail_evidence carve-out clause) is now factually inconsistent with our own data (data/wins.json:WIN-034.verdict = Self-Contradicted). Two lens-driven observations: (a) advocate mode identifies a partial-corroboration pivot in the comparative-religion list (Puranic + Mesopotamian traditions actually share flat-disc-with-central-sacred-mountain topology with dome cosmology); (b) quantitative verification confirms the corrected carve-out fraction (67/71 = 94.4%) if the stale WIN-034 reference is removed.

code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: The claim is not a physical prediction that standard physics also predicts; it is a textual-convergence claim. There is no standard-physics counterpart to relabel. The Zaphon-Zion typology and axis-mundi archetype belong to comparative religion / Ancient Near East studies (Cross 1973; Clifford 1972; Eliade 1958 — cited in scholarship, not in our current WIN-031 text), not physics.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: Post-hoc/prospective distinction does not apply meaningfully — all six biblical texts predate the dome model by ~2-3 millennia (Isaiah ~700 BCE, Job 6th-5th c BCE per source-critical scholarship, 1 Enoch latest layers ~100 BCE). The dome could not have "prospectively predicted" texts that already existed. Our detail_evidence correctly frames this as retrodiction rather than prediction. WIN-031.code_analysis.post_hoc_evidence in wins.json ("Unfalsifiable theological claim ... The prediction/retrodiction distinction does not apply to unfalsifiable assertions") is consistent with this framing.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: No formula derives "cosmic mountain at north pole" from dome parameters. The dome geometry defines r=0 as the disc center (which the dome equates to "north pole" in its cavity height function H(r) and toroidal flow model), but this is a naming choice, not a derivation of a mountain's existence. The biblical texts assert the mountain; the dome adopts them.

holes_found.description: Cross-WIN consistency: WIN-031 detail_evidence carve-out clause names WIN-034 as one of the "Unfalsifiable WINs in this cluster" ("e.g., WIN-032/034 ... the resulting fraction (66/70 = 94.3% if WIN-031, 032, and 034 are all carved out)"). But WIN-034 was re-classified from Unfalsifiable to Self-Contradicted on 2026-05-14 (see monitor/curmudgeon/reviews/WIN-034.c3.json), 11 days after WIN-031.c8 was written. Current data/wins.json:WIN-034.verdict = "Self-Contradicted". So the carve-out example is now internally inconsistent with our own data: we claim WIN-034 is in the Unfalsifiable theological-cross-reference cluster while our own registry says it is Self-Contradicted. A dome defender who audits our data catches this in one grep. The analytical core (the carve-out barely moves the scorecard) survives — the arithmetic still works — but the specific example lists a WIN we no longer classify that way. This is a durable cross-WIN drift the c8 review could not have anticipated because the verdict flip was still 11 days in the future.
holes_found.recommendation: Two clean options. (a) Drop WIN-034 from the cluster naming and update the arithmetic: replace "e.g., WIN-032/034" with "e.g., WIN-032" and replace "66/70 = 94.3% if WIN-031, 032, and 034 are all carved out" with "67/71 = 94.4% if WIN-031 and 032 are carved out" — mathematically verified this run (67/71 = 94.37%, 0.15pp from 94.52% base, still "approximately the same"). (b) Broaden the cluster naming to match the SEPARATE theological-content criterion instead of the verdict-only criterion: "e.g., WIN-032, plus other theological-primary-source WINs like WIN-034 whose central claim rests on scripture even where our verdict is Self-Contradicted rather than Unfalsifiable" and preserve the 66/70 arithmetic. Option (a) is simpler and less contortion; Option (b) preserves the original example if the operator prefers to keep the WIN-034 mention. Recommend (a).

holes_found.description: Advocate-mode partial-corroboration pivot: two of the five comparative-religion counter-examples cited in argument (2) share flat-disc-with-central-sacred-mountain topology with dome cosmology. Puranic Hindu Meru sits at the r=0 center of a flat bhū-maṇḍala disc surrounded by concentric continents; Mesopotamian Ḫursag/E-kur sits at the cosmic center of a flat-earth model. Both are topologically identical to dome cosmology (r=0 sacred structure on a flat disc surface). Our text lists these as "mutually contradictory geometric positions" but on inspection Puranic Hindu, Mesopotamian, and (arguably) Levantine Zaphon-Zion all converge on flat-disc-with-central/northern-sacred-mountain topology — that is 3 of 6 mythological convergences that match dome geometry at the topological abstraction level, plus one (Aryabhatan Hindu) that puts Meru at the north pole of a sphere (dome-defender-compatible if you squint), leaving only Norse Yggdrasil (compatible via vertical axis over a flat surface) and Islamic Qaf (perimeter — actually incompatible) as active outliers. A defender can pivot: "You listed 5 counter-examples; 3-4 of them actually corroborate our disc-center-with-sacred-mountain topology. Only Qaf actively contradicts." Our text does not preempt this. The response is that the CONVERGENCE IS AT THE TOPOLOGICAL ABSTRACTION LEVEL (sacred-point-at-center-of-disc) at which our discriminating-power argument operates — dome cosmology asserts additional ontological content (aetheric flow, firmament at 9,086 km, disc_radius 20,015 km, toroidal geometry) that Puranic Hindu and Mesopotamian do NOT share. Topological convergence at "sacred point at flat-disc center" is exactly the level at which the archetype is a cognitive universal and doesn't discriminate between the dome and any other flat-disc cosmology.
holes_found.recommendation: Add one sentence to argument (2), after the "mutually contradictory geometric positions" enumeration and before the "so the convergence on some-place-central" clause: "Some of these traditions — Puranic Hindu bhū-maṇḍala with Meru at r=0, Mesopotamian E-kur at flat-earth center — share flat-disc-with-central-sacred-mountain topology with dome cosmology, which is precisely the point: convergence at this level of abstraction reflects a cognitive-universals archetype (Boyer 2001; Lakoff & Johnson 1980 vertical/central metaphor) rather than corroboration of any specific ontological content — dome cosmology asserts aetheric flow, a firmament at 9,086 km, and disc_radius 20,015 km, none of which Puranic Hindu or Mesopotamian cosmology asserts." This preempts the defender pivot and simultaneously executes stronger_argument #2 from c8 (cognitive-universals literature citation).

stronger_arguments.description: Existing c8 stronger_argument #2 (cognitive-universals reframe) is now doubly motivated by the c9 advocate-mode finding. advocate_mode.best_defense: A capable dome defender constructs the c9 attack in two moves. Move 1 (cross-WIN inconsistency): "You claim WIN-034 is in the Unfalsifiable theological-cross-reference cluster with WIN-031/032, but your own data/wins.json says WIN-034 is Self-Contradicted. Your review contradicts itself across WINs. If your reviewers cannot keep their own verdict registry consistent within a single paragraph, why should anyone trust your carve-out math?" Move 2 (partial-corroboration pivot on the comparative-religion list): "You listed five contradictory-geometry counter-examples. On inspection, at least two — Puranic Hindu Meru at the r=0 center of a flat disc, and Mesopotamian Ḫursag/E-kur at the cosmic center of a flat earth — share flat-disc-with-central-sacred-mountain topology with our dome cosmology. Add Levantine Zaphon-Zion pointing to a northern sacred mountain on a flat-earth cartographic frame, and 3 of 6 traditions actually corroborate our disc-center topology. Yggdrasil is compatible (vertical axis over flat surface). Only Islamic Qaf (perimeter) actively contradicts. Your 'inconsistent geometries' framing collapses on inspection — the comparative-religion literature is a 5-to-1 vote in favor of flat-disc-with-central-sacred-mountain cosmology, i.e., our model." Move 1 is a real credibility hit (verifiable in seconds by grepping our own JSON); Move 2 is a substantive analytical challenge that requires our text to distinguish topological from ontological convergence.
advocate_mode.preemptive_recommendation: Both moves are addressable with the two hole-recommendations above: (a) fix the WIN-034 stale reference in the carve-out clause (hole #1); (b) add the topological-vs-ontological one-sentence preempt to argument (2) with cognitive-universals citations (hole #2, jointly executing c8's stronger_argument #2). After these fixes the Move 1 disappears entirely, and Move 2 becomes a much weaker "but the topological convergence isn't nothing" residue that our text has anticipated. Together these change the defense_survives rating from 3 to ~1.5.

deeper_analysis: The c9 spot-check catches one durable cross-WIN drift (the WIN-034 verdict-flip 11 days after c8 was written) and one advocate-mode residue (partial-corroboration pivot on the comparative-religion list). Both are addressable with sub-paragraph edits. The underlying WIN-031 argument — that the six-text convergence is retrodiction of a cognitive-universals archetype, and that the dome's own automated validation excludes the WIN even as the WIN is counted toward the scorecard — is robust. The most interesting c9 finding is meta: cross-WIN drift in a review project of 72 WINs is now the dominant source of new curmudgeon holes on well-worn WINs. When a related WIN's verdict flips (WIN-034 Unfalsifiable → Self-Contradicted on 2026-05-14), any other WIN's text that names that WIN as an example of the old classification silently rots. c8 was 2026-05-03; the flip was 2026-05-11 later; nobody re-examined WIN-031 in between. Recommend: (a) route hole #1 to the decider as a patchable minor edit — either fix (a) or fix (b) works, decider picks. (b) Route hole #2 to the analyst as a small expansion (add cognitive-universals citation drop; ~50-word insert into argument (2)). (c) Hole #3 (durability qualifiers on dome-side numbers) is defer-worthy — the drought means the numbers are stable for now. (d) Consider a lightweight cross-WIN staleness scan in the structure-integrity agent: for each WIN, grep the WIN's detail_evidence and detail_verdict_text for references to OTHER WIN ids (WIN-\d+) and flag any where the referenced WIN's current verdict differs from what the referencing WIN's text implies. That would catch this class of drift automatically. Not required — this is a rare pattern — but low-cost to implement if structure-integrity is looking for a new sweep.
